description_en: Queries the actual SCIM receiving configuration, the expected AgentCore synchronization switch, and the status of the most recent independent SCIM task. SAML configuration is not required beforehand
description_zh: 查询 SCIM 实际接收配置、AC 同步期望开关和最近一次独立 SCIM 任务状态。无需先配置 SAML
name: GetIdentityProviderSCIM

parameters.help_en: Required. The ID of the destination workspace. The region of the request must be the same as that of the destination workspace
parameters.help_zh: 必填，目标 Workspace 的标识；请求地域需与目标 Workspace 一致
parameters.name: workspace_id

code.description_en: The business result code. If the request fails, handle the issue based on the HTTP status code and the message
code.description_zh: 失败时结合 HTTP 状态及 message 处理

data.description_en: The result structure. For details, see the response fields of this operation. The response of an asynchronous write operation indicates that the request is accepted, but does not guarantee that the background task is completed
data.description_zh: 结果结构见本接口返回字段；异步写接口的返回表示受理，不保证后台任务已完成

configuration.description_en: The actual SAML configuration is read back on demand only in GetIdentityProvider. SCIM queries and preparations return the actual receiving status and URL
configuration.description_zh: SAML 实际配置只在 GetIdentityProvider 按需回读；SCIM 查询和准备返回实际接收状态及 URL

baseUrl.description_en: The URL configured for the external provisioning system. The presence of a URL does not mean that the external configuration is completed or AgentCore synchronization is enabled
baseUrl.description_zh: 配置给外部预配系统的 URL；有地址不代表已完成外部配置或开启 AC 同步
baseUrl.title_en: IdP 配置使用的 SCIM 地址
baseUrl.title_zh: IdP 配置使用的 SCIM 地址

status.description_en: A value of Enabled indicates that SCIM receiving is enabled, and Disabled indicates that it is disabled. This is not equivalent to the expected value of syncEnabled in AgentCore
status.description_zh: Enabled 表示已开启 SCIM 接收，Disabled 表示关闭；不等同 AC 的 syncEnabled 期望值

configuration.title_en: 上游实际接收状态及 URL
configuration.title_zh: 上游实际接收状态及 URL

operationStatus.description_en: The original status of the most recent independent SCIM operation task. An empty string ("") is returned if no historical tasks exist
operationStatus.description_zh: 最近一次独立 SCIM 操作任务的原始状态；没有历史任务时返回空字符串（""）
operationStatus.title_en: 最近一次 SCIM 操作任务状态
operationStatus.title_zh: 最近一次 SCIM 操作任务状态

syncEnabled.description_en: Do not pass true during CustomSSO initialization. It can only be updated later through UpdateIdentityProviderSCIM. Determine the result in combination with operationStatus
syncEnabled.description_zh: CustomSSO 初始化时不传 true；后续只能通过 UpdateIdentityProviderSCIM 更新，结果结合 operationStatus 判断
syncEnabled.title_en: 本地期望同步开关；需结合实际配置与任务记录判断生效
syncEnabled.title_zh: 本地期望同步开关；需结合实际配置与任务记录判断生效

data.title_en: SCIM 实际配置、期望同步开关及独立操作状态
data.title_zh: SCIM 实际配置、期望同步开关及独立操作状态

httpStatusCode.description_en: The processing status of the current request, which is not equivalent to the final result of the background task
httpStatusCode.description_zh: 本次请求的处理状态，不等同后台任务最终结果

message.description_en: The request acceptance or error message. For asynchronous tasks, check the task result by using the corresponding query operation
message.description_zh: 请求受理或错误消息；异步任务结果需按对应查询接口核对

requestId.description_en: The request ID. Used to associate this call with troubleshooting. Keep the ID if the request fails
requestId.description_zh: 用于关联本次调用与排障，失败时请保留

success.description_en: Indicates whether the current request is successful. A value of true indicates that the request is processed successfully. For asynchronous writes, you must continue to query the task results
success.description_zh: true 表示本次请求处理成功；异步写入仍需继续查询任务结果
